services.desc: MacLean Play Museum for Children Mon-Sat: 9 a.m. - 3:30 p.m. Sun: Noon - 3:30 p.m. The Illinois State Museum is open and welcomes you to our headquarters facility. There are three floors of exhibits for visitors to explore AND our Museum Shop is open on the first floor. Our space consists of several permanent exhibits while the rest of the galleries rotate exhibitions. The ISM-Springfield offers regular educational programs and special events that highlight the fascinating collection of the nearly 150-year-old institution (founded in 1877). Check out the visitor information tab as well as the exhibits tab. We look forward to your visit!! The Illinois State Museum Route 66 Oral History
